fun plan() {
  val planTools = readRepoFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/agent/plan-tools.md")
  val taskContext = readRepoFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/task-context.json")
  val evidenceExists = runCommand(argv = listOf("bash", "-lc", "if [ -e /tmp/gh-aw/evidence.json ]; then printf exists; else printf absent; fi"))
  val consolidatedEvidence = compute(planTools = planTools, taskContext = taskContext, evidenceExists = evidenceExists)
  val evidenceFile = writeFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/evidence.json", content = consolidatedEvidence)
  val safeOutput = publish(channel = "safeoutputs:noop", body = "No action needed: consolidated preflight evidence written to /tmp/gh-aw/evidence.json.")
}
